business_problem: Keller Williams needed to replatform large real-estate data workloads so agents and consumers could access listing information in real time without being slowed by oversized databases and outdated access patterns.
solution_summary: Keller Williams replatformed its Consumer and Command applications onto MongoDB Atlas as part of a broader transformation from real-estate company to technology platform. The business manages more than 500GB of property listing data and roughly 70 million records split between a fast faceted-search dataset and a much larger master property dataset, while also ingesting listing updates from multiple listing services every 15 minutes. To deliver real-time experiences, the engineering team shifted away from self-managed infrastructure and built a microservices architecture on Atlas. Four microservices now run on Atlas, with Atlas Search expanding how consumers discover properties and Atlas App Services handling event-driven synchronization so new listing data remains current without loss. The document model and managed platform let Keller Williams pair rapid application development with better query routing, giving agents and customers a more responsive way to browse listings, manage contacts, and act on opportunities.

solution_components.name: MongoDB Atlas
solution_components.role: Hosts Keller Williams' core listing and application data for the replatformed Command and Consumer applications.

solution_components.name: Atlas Search
solution_components.role: Expands property discovery beyond faceted search for consumers and agents.

solution_components.name: Atlas App Services
solution_components.role: Keeps listing updates synchronized through event-driven triggers and related application logic.

data_flow: Listing data from multiple listing services enters Keller Williams' Atlas-backed microservices, is synchronized through Atlas App Services, indexed for discovery with Atlas Search, and then served to Command and Consumer applications so agents and buyers can work from up-to-date property information.
business_outcome: Keller Williams improved access to real-time property information, sustained rapid transaction growth, and gave agents and consumers a more responsive search and engagement experience across its technology platform.
